answer: Randomized Witness Assignment. Each epoch, a public beacon draws an unpredictable timestamp; an identity earns standing only if it answers a liveness challenge within that window, and responders are matched to challengers by seeded shuffle. Attackers cannot precompute the draw, so every fake identity must stay live across the whole timber of uncertain timing. Missing a slot drops it off the ridge of eligible peers. Each surviving fake costs continuous monitoring plus a forfeited ledge of accrued standing, making mass identity farms expensive to sustain.
